findings.title: Unauthorised data transfer to US-hosted processing environment
findings.deviation: SyncRiver processes data in a US-hosted environment, whereas the underlying DPA restricts hosting to Azure West Europe (Netherlands) and prohibits non-EEA transfers without prior written consent.
findings.impact: Transferring personal data to the US without prior written consent and appropriate transfer mechanisms violates the data processing terms under the MSA.
findings.quote: Audience activation will use SyncRiver (SyncRiver Inc, Austin, Texas, USA), a reverse-ETL SaaS tool that copies segment tables into SyncRiver's US-hosted processing environment before pushing them to retail-media platforms.
findings.counterPosition: Obtain Corvina's prior written consent for US data transfer and ensure EU Standard Contractual Clauses or adequate safeguards are executed before SyncRiver processes any personal data.
findings.linkedQuote: Personal data shall be hosted only in Microsoft Azure West Europe (Netherlands). Remote access from India by AtliQ personnel is permitted under the EU Standard Contractual Clauses (Module 2, controller-to-processor) incorporated in Annex 2-C. No other transfer outside the EEA is permitted without Corvina's prior written consent.

findings.title: Sub-processor notice does not meet thirty-day advance requirement
findings.deviation: The sub-processor notice is provided concurrently with SOW-2 for work starting 12 October 2026, failing to provide the required 30 days' advance notice before new sub-processors begin processing personal data.
findings.impact: Engaging new sub-processors without observing the full 30-day advance notice period violates the agreed DPA terms under the MSA.
findings.quote: Attaching SOW-2 for the retail media project. As discussed, we'll be starting on 12 October. For your records, we're adding two sub-processors under the DPA: 1. Kriti Data Labs Pvt Ltd (Bengaluru) — model development 2. SyncRiver Inc (USA) — audience activation tool
findings.counterPosition: Issue the formal sub-processor notice at least 30 days prior to the date any personal data is shared with or processed by Kriti Data Labs or SyncRiver.
findings.linkedQuote: AtliQ shall inform Corvina in writing of any intended addition or replacement of a sub-processor at least thirty (30) days in advance, giving Corvina the opportunity to object. AtliQ shall not allow any new sub-processor to process personal data until that period has elapsed without objection.

fine.note: Invoices payable within 30 days matches standard.
IP allocation governed by MSA Section 5.
